acceptance.authority: Complete existing 41-production-authority guard inventory remains zero, including shared training.
acceptance.failure: Retain the first original error and completed/partial census, stop later work and do not retry or discard a run.
acceptance.source: Clean identical committed HEAD/status/39 LF hashes before and after the single batch.
acceptance.stable: Initial repeat and both restored graph digests and censuses exactly match.
acceptance.tamper: Root action-value and rooted node-index alias mutations change the fingerprint, and originals always restore in finally.
acceptance.validity: Unchanged full independent model validation before and after all probes; fingerprints alone never establish validity or authorize reuse.

preflight.interpretation: Named traversal reservations plus separate physical/source census bounds only; not all arithmetic, elapsed time, allocation, bytes or RSS.

scope.evidence: One fresh baseline fixed-support model and six fingerprints are census/integrity evidence only. No policy, quality, speed, RSS, memory advantage or broader card/action support claim.
scope.limits: Fingerprints detect changes between traversals; they do not prevent concurrent mutation, mutation-and-restoration, or prove poker semantics. No cache or validator bypass.
scope.method: Type-preserving streaming graph digest with traversal-local reference ordinals and bounded atomic set ordering.
scope.provenance: Project-owned standard-library implementation only; no third-party source or dependencies, shared kernels, defaults or Coach changes.
